headline: Nijman averages 103 to beat Cross in the Slovak Darts Open final
standfirst: Wessel Nijman won European Tour 9 in Bratislava, beating Rob Cross 8-3 in a final where both players averaged over 102.
body: Wessel Nijman won the Slovak Darts Open in Bratislava, beating Rob Cross 8-3 in a high-scoring final at the Incheba Expo. Nijman averaged 103.80 and Cross 102.57, but the Dutchman was far more clinical.

Nijman's run included a 6-1 win over Stephen Bunting in the last 16 and a 104.50 average in his 6-3 quarter-final win over Mike De Decker. He then edged Ross Smith 7-6 in the semi-finals. His 170 checkout against De Decker was the joint-highest finish of the event, matched by Jonny Clayton against Ryan Joyce.
Cross reached the final with wins over Nathan Aspinall 6-2, averaging 102.75, and Tom Sykes 7-2.

Aspinall's 108.65 average against Ryan Searle in the last 16 was the best of the weekend. Mike De Decker averaged 107.14 against William O'Connor, and Cameron Menzies 106.00 in a win over Gerwyn Price.
Cross and Smith hit 17 maximums each, the most at the event, with Nijman one behind on 15.
